text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon wins 1st place in her debut 
race, brilliantly claiming the center 
stage for the Winning Live.

Having learned the joy of performing 
center stage at a concert, her yearning to 
become a top Umadol grows even stronger.

If you aim for the top, the true path of 
an Umadol is to enter many races and gain 
fans through winning lives.

Then the goal is 2 or more wins in the 
Junior tier. They decided to take on 
Pre-OP or higher races to raise her 
profile.
